content:
Dongying ZhaoRui Science & Trading Co., Ltd is a professional chemical enterprise located at 233 Zhenxinglu, Kenli County, Dongying, China. Strategically situated in one of China’s important petrochemical and industrial regions, the company leverages its advantageous location to serve domestic and international markets with reliable supply chains, efficient logistics, and prompt customer service.

Founded with a focus on quality, safety and environmental responsibility, Dongying ZhaoRui specializes in the manufacture, sourcing and trading of a broad portfolio of chemical products for industrial, agricultural and specialty applications. Its product range includes basic industrial chemicals, specialty intermediates, solvents, and additives tailored to meet the needs of clients in coatings, plastics, rubber, agrochemicals and other downstream industries. The company combines production know-how with market insight to offer customized formulations, value-added technical support and flexible packaging options to customers of varying sizes.

Dongying ZhaoRui places emphasis on strict quality control and regulatory compliance. Its operational practices prioritize occupational safety, product consistency and environmental protection, and it works with suppliers and partners to ensure traceability and responsible sourcing. The company’s experienced technical and sales teams collaborate closely with clients to develop solutions that improve process efficiency, reduce costs and meet evolving industry standards.

Committed to building long-term partnerships, Dongying ZhaoRui offers competitive pricing, reliable delivery and responsive after-sales service. Whether supporting large-scale industrial projects or supplying critical specialty chemicals to niche manufacturers, the company aims to be a trusted partner for businesses seeking high-quality chemical products backed by professional service. For inquiries or to discuss tailored solutions, prospective customers are encouraged to contact Dongying ZhaoRui at its Kenli County headquarters on Zhenxinglu.
